subject: Private deployment pricing & packaging — HelionHealth
messages:
From: Markus Levin <contracts@helionhealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Amira Shah <amira.shah@helionhealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-13T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Private deployment — pricing and packaging questions

Hi Camila,

Thanks for the demo last week — the Helion technical team (Amira cc'd) and I had a couple of follow-ups specifically around the private/VPC deployment pricing and how you bundle the platform fee with support. A few items we need clarity on to move this forward with procurement: 

- Platform fee: can this be amortized over a term (we're evaluating a 36-month financial model)? If so, what does that look like if we do annual vs upfront payment?
- Support tiers: we typically need 24/7 on-call for critical workflows. Can you map estimated SLA response times and cost deltas for Bronze/Silver/Gold?
- Discounting: with ~70% of our traffic planned on-prem for the first 18 months and a committed 3-year term, what scale/discounts are available?
- Escrow/licensing: legal asked whether code escrow or enhanced license verbiage is possible for healthcare compliance.

Can you share a short commercial summary and a draft SOW we can circulate internally?

Appreciate a concise proposal we can take to our procurement committee — target decision date: mid-November.

Best,
Markus
Contracts, HelionHealth
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-13T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Private deployment — pricing and packaging questions (HelionHealth)

Team — forwarding Helion's note. Key asks: amortization option for platform fee, tougher SLA (24x7 on-call), 3y commit + 70% on-prem leading to discount ask, escrow/license detail.

Proposed commercial approach (draft):
- Blended commit: 3-year term with a blended annual commitment (covers hosted + private usage). If they commit 3 years we can offer to amortize the platform fee across the term for accounting purposes.
- Platform fee options: one-time $120,000 (standard) OR amortized at $40,000/yr with 36-mo commit (payments annual or quarterly).
- Support tiers (examples):
  * Silver: business-hours + 8x5 on-call, 24 hr P1 response — $9,000/yr
  * Gold: 24x7 on-call, P1 response within 2 hours, regular runbook syncs — $22,000/yr
  * Platinum: Gold + named on-call + quarterly on-site runbook review — $45,000/yr
- Onboarding credit: $15k credit toward migration services if they sign within 30 days.

Marissa, can you validate the technical feasibility of supporting 70% on-prem split for their first 18 months (prefetching, KV cache behavior, licensing enforcement)?
David — can we do an escrow/third-party signing approach or a clause referencing escrow provider with conditional release?

I'll draft a short commercial summary + SOW and send to Markus. Thoughts on concession bands? I suggest up to 20% off platform fee with a prepay/annual payment; larger discount (up to 30%) if they prepay 12 months upfront + sign a 36-month commitment.

Camila
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Markus Levin <contracts@helionhealth.com>
Cc: Amira Shah <amira.shah@helionhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-15T11:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment — pricing and packaging questions

Hi Markus — thanks for the clear list. Attached is a concise commercial summary and a draft SOW for your procurement and infra teams (attached: Helion_Proposal_v2.pdf, SOW_Helion_Draft.docx). Below is the executive summary to keep in the packet.

Executive commercial summary (HelionHealth)
- Term: 36 months (recommended)
- Platform fee: $120,000 one-time OR amortized $40,000/yr when amortized over 36 months (we can invoice annually or quarterly; payment terms net 45).
- Commitment discounting: 20% discount off platform fee if you sign a 36-month commitment with annual billing; 25% if you prepay the first 12 months at signing.
- Usage pricing: standard metered token rate for hosted traffic; private-hosted usage is included in the committed units up to agreed thresholds (details in SOW).
- Support: recommend Gold for Helion given critical workflows — $22,000/yr. Includes 24x7 on-call, 2-hr P1 response SLA, quarterly runbook reviews, and bi-weekly health checks for the first 6 months.
- Onboarding: $15,000 professional services credit applied against migration milestones (T&M for overages).
- Escrow & IP: we can add an addendum referencing a neutral escrow agent for the runtime artifacts required for emergency recovery; David from legal is cc'd for contract language.

Next steps:
1) Review attached proposal + SOW with procurement; share any redlines.
2) If acceptable, schedule a 30-min commercial alignment call this week to confirm payment timing (prepay vs annual) and finalize the support tier.

If you prefer a different packaging (seat/hosted split vs large platform fee), we can run a quick alternate view.

Thanks — attaching the two docs now.

Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Helion_Proposal_v2.pdf (commercial summary), SOW_Helion_Draft.docx (draft SOW)
From: Markus Levin <contracts@helionhealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Amira Shah <amira.shah@helionhealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-21T14:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment — pricing and packaging questions

Camila — thank you for the fast turnaround and the docs. Procurement ran some quick numbers and we have two follow-ups: 

1) Platform fee: $120k (or $40k/yr amortized) is better than we expected, but our CFO is pushing for a further concession given the high on-prem footprint and the industry-standard discounting for multi-year healthcare customers. Can you do 30% off the platform fee if we commit 36 months and prepay year 1?
2) Escrow: we need explicit language allowing an annual escrow verification report for our auditors; is that acceptable?
3) Support: Gold is fine, but if that is a $22k line item it needs to be fixed-price for the term (no annual increases) to get final approval.

If you can move on  (1) and confirm (2) and (3) we can put the PO in this month and target an early January go-live.

Cheers,
Markus
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Markus Levin <contracts@helionhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-25T16:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment — pricing and packaging questions

Markus — appreciate the direct ask and the timing pressure. Internal alignment:

- Platform fee concession: we can extend a 28% discount on the platform fee if Helion signs a 36-month agreement and prepays year 1 at signing. That lands the one-time equivalent at $86,400 (or $31,200/yr amortized). This is our final pricing band for prepay + 36m.
- Support: Gold will be fixed-price for the 36-month term at $22,000/yr with no annual increases.
- Escrow: David confirmed we can add an escrow addendum and provide an annual escrow verification statement for auditors (we'll use a standard escrow provider and add the procedural clause in the addendum).
- Onboarding credit: maintain the $15k credit applied against the first two migration milestones.

If Helion can confirm today / PO this week we will update the SOW and licensing exhibit to reflect prepay billing and the escrow addendum and route for signatures. If prepay isn't possible, we can keep the 25% discount with annual billing (no more than 25%).

Next step suggestion: 20-min call to confirm PO mechanics (who signs, billing contact, and legal redline process). I can send a short amendment showing the numbers and final concessions.

Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0183

Onward: attaching a short amendment draft in the shared link for your procurement team to review: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/HLN-2026-091
